{{Otheruses|Castle}}
A '''castle''' was a primitive form of fixed fortification typically made of local stone and any number of other building materials. Some castles, due to the unique material of their construction, would continue to be of practical use in an era of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]].

An example of such a castle was the [[Hand of Thrawn]].
